null when never read), a nullable ItemizedFeesTotal (decimal), a nullable PickupFee (decimal), and a nullable PickupLocation (string); adds to DealerEntity a nullable DocFee (decimal) and a nullable AddOnsNote (string); and creates a PostingAttributes table (PostingId, Name, Value, ObservedRunId, with a unique index on PostingId plus Name so a later observation replaces the earlier one); LedgerUpsertService gains a method that sets a posting\\u0027s attributes for a run; proven by ledger tests\u0022,\u0022DealerGradeCommand persists DocFee (the dollar amount CarEdge prints, parsed to a decimal) and AddOnsNote whenever it records a grade, and a new flag, odo dealer grade --all --refresh, re-checks dealers that are already graded (the checked-once rule stays the default), so dealers graded before this change can pick up their fee fields; proven by tests over the existing CarEdge fixtures\u0022,\u0022odo show prints the dealer\\u0027s doc fee and add-ons note on the dealer line of each posting when known, and prints a posting\\u0027s attributes as one line per name and value when any exist; rank is unchanged in this task; docs/ledger.md documents the new columns and the attributes table and states the rule: if arithmetic or a red flag reads a fact, it is a typed column; otherwise it is an attribute; dotnet build and dotnet test succeed with zero warnings; commits are small with conventional messages, no em dashes, no AI attribution\u0022],\u0022Type\u0022:\u0022Feature\u0022,\u0022AgentContext\u0022:\u0022First task from the discovery walk of idea adf5634b (site-specific logic per walk site), walked with Brian 2026-09-26 11:50 to 12:25 EDT; rulings are in ideas/adf5634b-site-specific-logic-for-each-walk-site-use-each-site-s-own-f/workspace/journal.md, stops 1, 2, and 4. His rulings: fees are an input to rank plus a flag, never a filter; Carvana pickup is an option recorded beside delivery, never a locked-in default; typed columns for anything arithmetic or a red flag reads, an attributes table for badges and ratings, with that rule written in the ledger doc. This task builds the storage only; two follow-ups read the walk pages into it. Code: src/Odonomics/Ledger/Entities.cs (PostingEntity has Id, VehicleVin, Source, Url, FirstSeen, LastSeen, DealerId, ShippingFee; DealerEntity has Name, Location, NormalizedName, NormalizedLocation, Grade, GradeReason, GradeCheckedAt); src/Odonomics/CarEdge/CarEdgeGradeResult.cs already carries DocFee (a string like the dollar amount) and AddOnsNote, populated by CarEdgeGradeParser.cs lines 175 to 180, and src/Odonomics/Cli/Commands/DealerGradeCommand.cs lines 199 to 215 write Grade, GradeReason, and GradeCheckedAt and drop the rest; ShippingFee (PR #45) is the precedent for a typed cost column and its migration. Blocked on 5aebca52 (the README restructure) so the documentation lands in docs/ledger.md rather than the old README.
